reason: I have one apartment and I answer my guests myself, even at night. That is how we welcome people here, and for one unit I don't need a machine to tell them the Wi-Fi password.
objection: My guests ask the same three questions and I already answer them. €120 is real money for me, and I don't want a guest to feel they are talking to a computer instead of to me.
would_change_my_mind: If my daughter set it up and showed me that it answers my German guests properly so I don't have to translate at midnight in August, and maybe a cheaper price for just one small apartment.
